name: Laimonade.com
description:
Your coding agents can already write the code. The bottleneck is everything around it: deciding what to build next, writing it down well enough to hand over, and knowing when it is actually finished.

Laimonade is an AI Product Owner that grooms the backlog and runs the sprint. This connector gives your coding agent direct access to it, so work moves off the board and into the agent without anyone pasting a ticket into a prompt.

Ask what is ready this sprint and you get the real Ready column back. Load a story and you get the whole thing — description, acceptance criteria, estimate, and the epic it sits under. Before touching a file, your agent can pull the regression notes for the paths it is about to edit, and your project's own conventions: the CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and Cursor rules your team already wrote. Bugs it trips over along the way are filed against the item that surfaced them, so you can see later what caused what. When the work is done, it hands the item back for review.

What it deliberately cannot do matters as much. Nothing here marks work done: an agent submits for review, and deciding something is finished stays with a person. Unattended implementation is opt-in per item and set by a human, an agent cannot add work to that queue, including its own. A connection is bound to one project and sees only that project's backlog, sprints, roadmap and rules. It never reads your chat history, Claude's memory, or files you have uploaded.

Built for teams whose agents ship faster than their planning can keep up.

You will need a Laimonade account with at least one project and an active sprint. Adding a second project means connecting again and signing in to it — every reply names the project it came from, so you always know which backlog answered.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Laimonade.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Laimonade.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.laimonade.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Laimonade.com MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Laimonade.com lists 27 MCP tools, including add_to_active_sprint, archive_backlog_item, create_bug, create_epic, create_improvement, create_milestone, create_story, get_all_ready, get_autopilot_queue, get_backlog_context, get_backlog_item, and get_bugs.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Laimonade.com?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Laimonade.com in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Laimonade.com requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Laimonade.com is developed by Digiscope. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
